content:
meta glasses + chatgpt voice running live on my machine at home. didn't build any software or hardware. honestly blown away how close to jarvis this feels.

just prepped for a meeting by talking to my agent while eating. hands free, screen free.

you can finally touch grass while prompting. what would you run through glasses?

metadata.screenshot_suggestion: Photo of the Meta glasses on the table in front of your home machine with the ChatGPT voice session visible on screen — or a POV shot mid-meal with the agent conversation running
